title: hero cololors official mod
description: An official mod based on the Hero Colors series, featuring costumes, powers, and much more.
body:
An official mod based on the Hero Colors series, featuring costumes, powers, and much more.

This mod introduces the unique costumes and abilities of Greenix and Yellowix directly into the base game, allowing players to experience the Hero Colors universe in an interactive way.

🎨 Features
Custom Costumes:

Greenix outfit with his signature green fabrics, insect-inspired design, and emblem.

Yellowix outfit with bright yellow fabrics, aviation-themed details, and symbol.

Exclusive Fabrics and Symbols: Adds new textures and emblems that represent each hero’s identity, giving players a strong visual connection to the Hero Colors lore.

Abilities Integration:

Greenix costume grants enhanced jumping ability, reflecting his “Super Jump” power.

Yellowix costume unlocks flight mechanics, inspired by his “Flight” power.

🕹️ Gameplay Impact
Costumes are not just cosmetic — they provide functional powers that change how players explore and interact with the world.

Wearing Greenix’s outfit allows players to reach higher areas and move with agility.

Wearing Yellowix’s outfit opens up aerial exploration, offering new strategies and perspectives.

The fabrics and symbols enrich immersion, making the player feel part of the Hero Colors saga.

🌟 Why Download
Brings the Hero Colors universe into the game with authentic visuals and abilities.

Offers a new roleplay experience, letting players embody Greenix or Yellowix.

Enhances exploration and gameplay variety with powers that go beyond cosmetics.

Perfect for fans of Hero Colors who want to extend the story into their own adventures.
